scope: Exact nearest-window criterion for full-target beta half-bound failure, congruence-only relaxation, seed-specific Turan defect, one-step Euclidean descent, proper-target asymmetry, and zero-booking admission verdict

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: For a=q_(n-1), b=q_n, c=q_(n-2), A=4n-2, the nearest integers to a^2/b and ac/b are unique.
claims.evidence: report Section 2; adjacent coprimality, odd b, and exclusion of half-integer ties

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: rho_n<a/2 iff H=nint(ac/b) satisfies H congruent a mod A and |H-ac/b|<Aa/(2b)=1/2-c/(2b).
claims.evidence: report Section 3; exact identity A r_n=b(a-A kappa_n)-ac

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: The bare congruence H congruent a mod A is equivalent only to the relaxed threshold rho_n<b/(2A)=a/2+c/(2A).

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: The exact base rows n=2,3,4 satisfy the half-bound, so a minimal counterexample would have n at least 5.

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: For T_n=bc-a^2 and t_n=c-kappa_n, one has T_n>0, T_n+T_(n-1)=4ac, and t_n=nint(T_n/b).

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: For n at least 4, the seed-specific bounds (4c-d)/A<T_n/b<(5c-d)/(A+1) imply 1<=t_n<c.

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: With B=A-4, d=q_(n-3), h=a-A kappa_n, and K=kappa_n-Bh, the determinant descends exactly as r_n=dh-cK and the affine-slice defect is t_n=c-kappa_n.

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: Projection to the previous square slice gives c^2-ah=ct_n-r_n and cent_a(ct_n-r_n)=r_(n-1).

claims.label: PROVED SCOPED DESCENT OBSTRUCTION
claims.claim: From n=4 onward, the natural determinant-preserving one-step descent misses the previous affine square slice by t_n; correcting it introduces the moving translation ct_n, so minimality alone returns only the already-known previous centered residue.
claims.scope_limit: does not exclude a coupled descent controlling t_n, T_n, or further Bessel data

claims.label: OPEN
claims.claim: The all-n half-bound rho_n>=a/2, the stronger inequality A(2rho_n-a)>=2c, and exclusion of the bare congruence remain open.
claims.scope_limit: the exact equality at base row n=4 is not extrapolated

claims.label: PROVED ASYMMETRIC
claims.claim: For a proper divisor target Q, the centered residue can only decrease in absolute size, so a full-target lower bound would not transfer while a full-target upper construction would.

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: The additive least-lift quotient remains separate from the Item282 common coefficient/product baseline.

claims.label: EXACT FINITE ONLY
claims.claim: The checker replays bounded instances of the exact nearest-window, Turan, determinant, defect, projection, and base-row identities.
claims.scope_limit: no counterexample search, asymptotic extrapolation, or exceptional-prime search

strict_labels.booking: zero new Route-1 rate and zero new beta capacity reduction
